questions.title: Which AI tools did you use this week?
questions.description: Anything counts: ChatGPT, Copilot, Claude, Gemini, Cursor, Grammarly, Midjourney, an Ollama model, none.

questions.title: Describe one moment an AI interface frustrated or misled you.
questions.description: One or two sentences. What did you expect, and what happened instead?
questions.clusterHint: Where possible, name the interface failure rather than the product. Good theme names look like: "no indication of confidence", "silently ignored my instruction", "could not tell what it can do", "lost context mid-task", "no way to undo".

questions.title: Which of these is AI to you?
questions.description: Pick one: oracle / assistant / tool / colleague / threat / toy — or add your own.

questions.title: Name a task where an interface should not use AI.
questions.description: Be specific: what task, and why not.
